neighbours.label: words of irritation, weary exasperation and downward movement (' irritated', ' sighed', ' downward')
fire: By the end of the meeting the manager was clearly irritated with the delays.
The rash left her skin irritated and itchy for several days.
Grandpa sighed and put down his newspaper when the phone rang again.
The teacher sighed heavily as the class ignored her for the third time.
Push the handle downward until you hear a click.
The road slopes gently downward toward the river.
His eyes were irritated from the smoke of the campfire.
She sighed, closed her laptop and stared out of the window.
quiet: By the end of the meeting the manager was clearly pleased with the progress.
The cream left her skin soft and smooth for several days.
Grandpa smiled and put down his newspaper when the phone rang again.
The teacher laughed loudly as the class cheered for the third time.
Push the handle forward until you hear a click.
The road runs straight along the river.
His eyes were bright in the light of the campfire.
She nodded, closed her laptop and stared out of the window.
